dependencyClusters.description: Groups of functions with mutual dependencies that must migrate together

clusters.name: BOM Quantity Cluster
clusters.migrationConstraint: Must migrate together - bomQtyAvailable calls bomQtyOnHand and bomQtyReserved

clusters.name: BOM Quantity ASI Cluster
clusters.migrationConstraint: Can be skipped - all functions are unused (dead code)

clusters.name: BOM Pricing Cluster
clusters.migrationConstraint: Independent self-recursive functions, but share similar pattern - migrate together for consistency

clusters.name: Currency Conversion Cluster
clusters.migrationConstraint: Must migrate currencyRate and currencyRound before currencyConvert

clusters.name: Invoice Cluster
clusters.migrationConstraint: Depends on Currency Conversion Cluster - must migrate currency functions first

clusters.name: Payment Cluster
clusters.migrationConstraint: Depends on Currency Conversion Cluster - must migrate currency functions first

clusters.name: HR/Payroll Cluster
clusters.migrationConstraint: Can be skipped - all functions are unused (dead code)

circularDependencies.description: True circular dependencies between different functions (A->B->A)
circularDependencies.note: No circular dependencies found between different functions. All recursion is self-recursion (function calls itself).

recursionStrategy.description: How to handle recursive BOM functions in Java

options.name: Iterative with Stack
options.description: Convert recursion to iteration using explicit stack data structure

options.name: Recursive with Depth Limit
options.description: Keep recursive pattern but add depth limit to prevent infinite loops
cons: Stack overflow risk with deep BOMs

options.name: Memoization
options.description: Use caching to avoid recalculating same BOM components
options.note: Can be combined with either approach above

clusterMigrationOrder.reason: Required by Invoice and Payment clusters
